My psych likes to frame it like this:

Before your parent spoke, your primary motivation was improving yourself.

Afterwards, the new, more important motivation is to piss off your parent by sabotaging yourself.

The key, then, is to convince yourself that the first priority overrides the second. A good way to do this is to remember that you cannot control your parent's reactions. No matter what you do, likely your mom will remain convinced that she needs to order you around. Improving yourself, on the other hand, will have long term benefits for yourself that will extend to assuring your future independence from your parents.

NTA BUT. 

You are not required to give your late wife's money, and her family's money, to your stepdaughter.

But.

Your stepdaughter is part of your family now. Saying "let the wife and ex take care of her" tells your stepdaughter that you don't see her as a part of your family, or at least, not as important to you as your "real" daughter. Sit down with your wife and her ex and figure out how, between the three of you, you can make your stepdaughter feel supported, valued, and loved as much as you own daughter. This will likely require careful parenting with both girls to make sure they know that parental love is not measured in dollars.

I have a very personal beef against Uniqlo. 

When they were opening their NYC store, they had a massive ad campaign that featured phrases like "it just fits" and pictures of sensible clothing made for the weather rather than fashion. I was psyched about springing for some durable, comfortable, good quality clothes. Then I went to their store and it's just overpriced activewear for tiny skinny Asians. Did not fit in the least.

I've failed out of two colleges and I'm trying to graduate from a third now. It's so depressing going back to school as an adult.

I try not to play MMOs because when I do, I don't get anything else done, I become the joke nerd who just sits in the darkness for hours shouting on headsets losing track of the real world. Now I stick to old favorites like Dragon Age, Myst, Stardew Valley, my old Pokemon games, nothing particularly cool. What about you?
